decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks fit closely with the firm's established dental lab materials and thermoforming know-how, and their continued standalone presentation suggests enough market acceptance to justify further incremental improvement.

The PETG thermoforming blank builds directly on the firm's core competence in dental workflow materials and precision manufacturing, so the firm is well placed to learn from use and refine it commercially.

A UV-curing lacquer is a related consumable within the firm's custom-device and laboratory materials base, and even with modest website prominence it likely strengthens the broader workflow offering enough to retain.

Although earmolds are related to the firm's hearing-care capabilities, the product line's disappearance from the website by 2019 is a strong early signal of weak traction or replacement, so resources are better redirected to stronger adjacent products.

Custom hearing protection earmolds are strongly aligned with the firm's existing hearing-care knowledge, channels, and custom manufacturing capabilities, and their continued listing indicates a viable niche the firm can keep developing.
